## Safety and operational boundary

- [ ] No claim of site validation or safe physical control is made without independent evidence.
- [ ] Telemetry/device changes remain read-only unless a separately authorized safety review explicitly permits otherwise.
- [ ] Failure modes, invalid inputs, stale data, and infeasible decisions fail closed where relevant.
